title: P&G to Webcast the Procter & Gamble 2026 Virtual Annual Meeting of Shareholders October 13
summary: P&G to Webcast the Procter & Gamble 2026 Virtual Annual Meeting of Shareholders October 13
body_markdown:
CINCINNATI--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE: PG) will webcast its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, held virtually via a live audio webcast on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time at:[www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com/PG2026](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.virtualshareholdermeeting.com%2FPG2026&esheet=54615844&newsitemid=20261006250413&lan=en-US&anchor=www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com%2FPG2026&index=1&md5=3d7d6e09219266e5756c615ef860da3b) .


Media and investors may access the live webcast beginning at 8:45 a.m., approximately 15 minutes before the annual meeting’s 9:00 a.m. start time.


The webcast will also be available for replay. For information on meeting business and shareholder voting, P&G’s Notice of Annual Meeting and Proxy Statement is available at[www.pginvestor.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.pginvestor.com&esheet=54615844&newsitemid=20261006250413&lan=en-US&anchor=www.pginvestor.com&index=2&md5=5dac90a1611402a8a2e2575ae5a46151) .


**About Procter & Gamble**


P&G serves consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ambi Pur®, Ariel®, Bounty®, Charmin®, Crest®, Dawn®, Downy®, Fairy®, Febreze®, Gain®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Lenor®, Olay®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, SK-II®, Tide®, Vicks®, and Whisper®. The P&G community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
